certificate_wording: Mastemy Certificate of Completion — Space Mission Operations

learning_outcomes.text: Describe the phases of a space mission from launch to end-of-life
Explain the roles of the ground segment and mission control
Describe telemetry, tracking and command concepts
Explain flight dynamics, planning and anomaly response at a concept level
Describe space situational awareness and debris mitigation concepts
Communicate operational trade-offs and risk to stakeholders

integrative_case: An operations class plans, at concept level only, the operations of a civil Earth-observation satellite: they lay out mission phases, the ground segment and TT&C, flight-dynamics planning and contact scheduling, and anomaly and end-of-life/debris handling, presenting operational trade-offs for review.
assesses: knowledge and applied reasoning on every in-scope outcome via MCQ/MR
case-based decisions in the integrative case
